svg.title: OpenNVR Agent
svg.desc: Animated demo: the OpenNVR agent watches two cameras (Lobby and RoadCam). A user asks about plate H644LX; the agent searches history and answers while live detection counts people in the lobby and reads plate 66HH07 on the road. That plate is on the watchlist, so the Set alarms automation fires, the activity feed turns red and the agent speaks the alert.
svg.text: Ask your cameras anything, by chat or voice.
It watches, reads plates and speaks up.

g.text: did you see car with number plate H644LX?
Yes — H644LX was read on RoadCam at 06:50 PM.

svg.text: stt → route → llm → search_history → llm → tts
